_doc: Level G proportions, RIG-CAL strand 2026-10-26: rig F re-solved so the rig rendered at rest through the GAME cameras (ortho, 30 deg elevation, 48 px figure) matches the 2D template/blockouts (v2/prop/blockout/<V>.txt, sections by v2/prop/tools/verify.py method) within +-1 px in S, SE and E. Multipliers relative to AB4 parts v2/hy3d/partsAB4f (as PROPORTIONS_F.json) plus RIGCAL keys implemented by v2/rigcal/scripts/repro_g.py (superset of hy3d/scripts/reproportion.py). Apply: <hunyuan venv python> -I v2/rigcal/scripts/repro_g.py PROPORTIONS_G.json v2/hy3d/partsAB4f v2/hy3d/best/skel.txt OUT/parts ; blend: MOCAP=1 ELBOW=1 Blender -b --factory-startup -P v2/throw/scripts/rig_lib.py -- OUT/parts OUT/parts/skel.txt rest_keys.json OUT rest SE,E,S
source: v2/prop/blockout/*.txt (template v2/prop/template.json); solver v2/rigcal/scripts (cal.py measure loop, search.py greedy pattern search, check.py)

keys_rigcal.head.fringe: lift the front hairline (input head units) -> eyes can sit higher
keys_rigcal.neck.r: skin neck cylinder (radius) on the torso, visible 1-2 px neck
keys_rigcal.torso.sh / torso.sq: square shoulders (x ramp / lift of the outer shoulder slope)
keys_rigcal.arms.dy: raise shoulder joints to the shoulder line
keys_rigcal.legs.thigh / legs.shin: segment length multipliers about the knee (on top of legs.length)
keys_rigcal.legs.prof: absolute leg profile [thigh_x, thigh_z, shin_x, shin_z] glb units
keys_rigcal.boots.top: clean boot line height above the sole (recolour)
keys_rigcal.boots.sx/sz/centre/ankle: foot size / centred under the leg / profile stops at the ankle

calibration_convention.fit: render_jobs FIG_EXCL=bow,bun FIG_PX=50: 50 px vertex extent (hair crown -> sole, SE rest pose {}) = 48 px measured by the verify method at 1x (coverage>0.5 loses ~1 px top+bottom); soles row 61
calibration_convention.crown: measured with bow+bun hidden (HIDE=bow,bun), as template.json excludes them
calibration_convention.SE_note: the 2D SE masters draw both legs side by side (front-ish legs); the SE calibration render therefore uses rig_lib's existing per-pose 'cheat' (hips yaw toward the camera) of -45 to measure per-leg sizes. With the true 45 deg camera the two legs overlap into one column (see residuals SE_true).

residuals: rig G - blockout (1x px, prop/tools/verify section method; rows absolute in the 64 cell, sole line 62; widths px). '!' = |r|>1, '-' = not checked in that view, '?' = not found
calib: pose {} + upper_arm abd 15, FIG_EXCL=bow,bun FIG_PX=50 (measured crown->sole 48 in SE), HIDE=bow,bun for the crown, HEADS_SE=1.0, SE calib pose legs cheat -45 (SE_true = no cheat)
